candidates.name: OGC API – Moving Features
verified_facts: OGC defines a standard interface for querying and accessing geospatial data that changes over time.
The API supports operations involving location, time and properties of moving features.
semantic_limits: A moving-feature interface does not establish static parcel ground elevation, source raster lineage or vertical measurement accuracy.

candidates.name: Location Service (OpenLS)
verified_facts: OpenLS specifies interfaces for location-based services such as navigation, routing, proximity and asset location.
The standard is about interoperable location-service application interfaces.
semantic_limits: A location-service result or route position is not a parcel terrain observation and does not certify geometry or elevation accuracy.
